summary: Moved all date/time parsing into deskstats/timeparse.py, rewired every module to use it, and added tests/test_timeparse.py; existing tests pass. Quirks kept as-is (e.g. site/sources disagreeing on offsets, two-digit years, 24:00); the one deliberate difference is that out-of-range epochs (inf, huge values) and a 24:00 on the last day now raise ValueError (so the CLI reports a data error) instead of OverflowError/OSError crashes.
